hero.title: Pay, gather & vote — in one app.
hero.sub: One app for the whole of campus life.
hero.body: A white-label app your student association brands as its own — your name, your logo, your colors, your modules. Built by students, open source — we deploy, ship and maintain it for you.
hero.phoneAlt: Phone showing a QR payment of twelve euros, paid

brand.title: Brand it
brand.desc: Your logo & colors, applied across every screen. It reads as yours from launch.

modules.title: Pick your modules
modules.desc: Payments, events, news, campaigns — compose the app your association needs.

deploy.title: We deploy
deploy.desc: Shipped to the app stores and hosted — iOS, Android and Web, all handled.

support.title: We support
support.desc: End to end. Updates, questions and fixes — a student team that has your back.

flagship.title: Get paid in one scan.
flagship.lead: Members scan a code and it's done. Dues, event tickets, shop purchases — paid instantly, straight to your association. No card readers, no queues, no fees.
flagship.p1: One scan to pay — dues, events and the shop.
flagship.p2: Instant confirmation for member and treasurer alike.
flagship.p3: No fees. What's collected is what you keep.

composer.title: Pick the modules your association needs.
composer.intro: Tell us what you need — we ship your app with those modules enabled. Start with payments, add more as your year grows.
composer.previewAria: Live preview of the app with the selected modules

branding.title: One app, every identity.
branding.intro: The same codebase, re-skinned end to end for each association — logo, colours, name in the stores. No version is the “real” one; they’re all first-class. Switch below.
branding.caption: Live today as MyECL and myemapp — yours is next.

build.title: From your brief to the stores.
build.lead: You send the brand and pick the modules. We build, ship and host it — you stay a student association, not a software team.
build.termAria: Terminal: proxima builds a white-label app named BDE Lyon and ships it to iOS, Android and Web, hosted and supported.
build.done: live in the stores — we host & support it.

oss.title: Two repositories. Nothing hidden.
oss.titanDesc: One Flutter codebase for iOS, Android and Web — shipped to the stores as MyECL, myemapp, or a school's own name. The white-label surface members hold in their hands.
oss.hyperionDesc: A small, vital core — auth, permissions, migrations — plus composable modules. Everything an association runs on, open to read and audit. We deploy, extend and maintain it for you.
oss.liveOn: Live on 2 campuses — École Centrale de Lyon · emlyon business school
